items.title: UKRI Enabling AI adoption closes 1 Dec, 16:00
items.text: Eight days left; you need an AI or domain co-lead and your research office's internal sign-off.

items.title: Horizon wave and tidal call opens 3 Dec
items.text: One €43m grant, closing 31 March; ask your contacts now which consortium still needs a wave-loading partner.

items.title: A Bayesian measure of wave predictability
items.text: Du, Maki and Sun map posterior uncertainty from one sensor; it matches the classical predictable zone and extends it to unbounded spectra.

items.title: Extreme-wave forecast from a single observation
items.text: Hilliard, Chabchoub and Farazmand reconstruct and forecast rogue waves from one measurement.
